name: Chair Figure-Four Stretch
steps: Sit tall on a sturdy chair with both feet flat on the floor.
Lift your right leg and rest your right ankle across your left knee, creating a 'figure-4' shape.
Keep your right foot lightly flexed to protect your knee joint.
With your spine tall and chest lifted, gently hinge forward from your hips until you feel a comfortable stretch in your outer right hip.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing calmly, then return upright and repeat on the other side.
coaching_cues: Hinge forward from your hip crease rather than rounding through your spine.
Do not press forcefully down on your raised knee.
Ideal for breaking up long periods of sitting at a desk.
